question: Motion to Discharge S. Res. 852 — A resolution requesting information on Israel's human rights practices pursuant to section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.
plain_language: This was a vote to pull from committee a resolution requesting information on Israel's human rights practices under section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act. It is not a final vote on the resolution. A Yea would have brought it to the floor; a Nay leaves it in committee.
